Cincinnati has won five straight, scoring at least 31 points in each of those games. news.analysis: Vidal was productive in the close loss, averaging 5.1 yards per carry behind starter Omarion Hampton. Vidal could be in line for a larger role moving forward as Keaton Mitchell missed time in Week 11 with back and knee issues. The Chargers will now prepare to face the Patriots in Week 12.
news.contents: Kimani Vidal carried the ball seven times for 36 yards and caught both of his targets for 18 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Jets in Week 11.
news.title: Kimani Vidal rolls up 54 all-purpose yards in Week 11

news.contents: Los Angeles Chargers running back Kimani Vidal took a backseat in the Chargers' Week 10 victory over the Baltimore Ravens. Vidal finished with two carries for zero yards as Omarion Hampton stole the show on Monday Night Football. The 25-year-old was uninvolved in the offense and saw his lowest snap percentage since Week 3. With Hampton's emergence, Vidal's fantasy value slides back to a handcuff running back at best. Vidal enters Week 11 as RotoBaller's PPR RB40 in a plus matchup against the ...
news.title: Kimani Vidal Off Fantasy Radars in Week 11 vs. Jets

news.contents: George Pickens caught 7-of-10 targets for 102 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
news.title: George Pickens catches touchdown Sunday

news.contents: Dallas Cowboys wide receiver George Pickens continued his strong 2026 season, recording seven catches on 10 targets for 102 yards (14.6 yards per reception) and a touchdown in a 51-30 win over the Tennessee Titans in Week 11. Pickens also recorded one rush for six yards. His touchdown came on a 10-yard pass from quarterback Dak Prescott in the second quarter, and Pickens' longest play of the day went for 31 yards. Fellow wideout CeeDee Lamb paced the Cowboys with 12 targets, 11 receptions and ...
news.title: George Pickens Continues to Roll in Win Over Titans

news.analysis: Washington led Miami pass catchers in receptions on the day. He remains a borderline WR3/flex play in deeper leagues moving forward.
news.contents: Malik Washington caught 3-of-6 targets for 30 yards in the Dolphins 26-9 loss against the Bills.
news.title: Malik Washington catches three passes Sunday

news.analysis: Despite exiting the game early due to a hip issue, Boutte caught his third TD of the season Thursday night. It's difficult to project Boutte week-to-week, as he caught his previous two touchdown passes in Week 9 only to post a goose egg in Week 10. The 24-year-old speedster fits the boom-or-bust label quite well.
news.contents: Kayshon Boutte hauled in both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
news.title: Kayshon Boutte hits paydirt in Week 11 win

news.contents: Houston Texans wide receiver Kayshon Boutte (hip) was moving well after his team's Week 11 win over the Indianapolis Colts on Thursday night and appears to have avoided a serious hip injury, per Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston. The 24-year-old finished the night with two catches for 40 yards and a touchdown on two targets and has now hauled in 21 catches for 359 yards and three touchdowns on 31 targets across 10 games. Boutte is a pure downfield threat who is averaging 17.1 yards per reception, ...
news.title: Kayshon Boutte Appears to Have Avoided Serious Hip Injury

news.contents: While it hasn't always translated into strong fantasy output, Washington Commanders tight end Chig Okonkwo has seen steady volume and could post a few breakout games in short order. Okonkwo has been far from a fantasy darling in his short career, finishing no higher than the TE21 during his time with Tennessee. That said, the 6-foot-3 University of Maryland product moves well for his size and has seen solid volume in his first season with Washington. Since Week 5, he's averaging 4.6 receptions ...
news.title: Chig Okonkwo an Appealing Option Down the Stretch

news.contents: Cincinnati Bengals kicker Evan McPherson's streak of perfection came to an end in last week's 38-18 victory over the Pittsburgh Steelers. McPherson missed his first kick of the season on a 43-yard field goal attempt in the second quarter of Week 10. Despite the missed field goal, the Bengals kicker was perfect on all five of his extra-point attempts in the contest. McPherson will look to begin a new streak of made field goals as the team travels to Washington to face the Commanders. This ...
news.title: Evan McPherson Looking To Get Back On Track Against Commanders

news.analysis: McCarthy didn't have a big game by any means, but he did enough to keep the Giants ahead and in control for the majority of the game, and greatly helped by the defense putting them in good spots. It would have been nice to see him complete more than 50% of his passes, but he isn't complaining after the win.
news.contents: J.J. McCarthy completed 18-of-38 passes for 173 yards and a touchdown and also ran seven times for 33 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
news.title: J.J. McCarthy has modest game against Jaguars

news.contents: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy will face one of the better defenses in the NFL in the Jacksonville Jaguars in Week 11. They have been lockdown against opposing quarterbacks this season, allowing an average of just 13.2 fantasy points per game. Though they're bottom-half in the league in passing yards per attempt allowed, they've been adept at preventing opposing signal-callers from pushing the ball into the end zone. McCarthy has shown solid rushing upside, which has helped lift his ...
news.title: J.J. McCarthy Faces Tough Week 11 Test As Giants Starting QB

news.analysis: Etienne continues to serve as the backup behind Chuba Hubbard. He is not currently seeing enough touches to be fantasy viable heading into Week 12.
news.contents: Trevor Etienne rushed for 29 yards on six carries in a 35-33 win over the Ravens. He caught his lone target for seven yards.
news.title: Trevor Etienne sees seven touches in Week 11 win

news.contents: Carolina Panthers running back Chuba Hubbard handled 27 of the backfield's 33 carries in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Baltimore Ravens. He ran for 120 yards, scored twice and added a two-point conversion. Trevor Etienne took the other six carries. Hubbard's longest run took Carolina inside the five early in the third quarter, and he finished the drive with a one-yard touchdown that put the Panthers back in front. Hubbard has now carried 27 times in back-to-back games. He went without a target ...
news.title: Chuba Hubbard's Lead Role Keeps Him in RB2 Range

news.analysis: Bateman found the end zone on a 52-yard touchdown pass from Jacoby Brissett early in the first quarter. It ended a long touchdown drought for Bateman, marking his first touchdown reception since Week 2. Bateman and the Ravens will take on the Texans in Week 12.
news.contents: Rashod Bateman caught 2-of-6 targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in a 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
news.title: Rashod Bateman finds the end zone in Week 11 loss

news.contents: With Jacoby Brissett at quarterback, Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Rashod Bateman took a step forward last week, recording three receptions for 42 yards during a loss to the Los Angeles Chargers. This week, Bateman and the Ravens take on the Carolina Panthers, who allowed New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson to record 11 receptions for 80 yards a week ago. While Bateman is not the Ravens' top option in the passing game, he has been a reliable option at times this season and ...
news.title: Rashod Bateman With a Glimmer of Hope

news.contents: Denver Broncos wide receiver Courtland Sutton has been a more consistent fantasy option in recent weeks. Over the last three games, Sutton has finished with 45 receiving yards or more in all those contests. In Week 9, Sutton saw a season-high nine targets, hauling in five of them for 45 yards in the win. The hope is that his consistent play will continue against the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 11. The Raiders come into this game ranked 24th in pass defense. It's worth noting that Jaylen Waddle ...
news.title: Courtland Sutton is a Flex Play for Week 11

news.contents: New York Jets wide receiver Garrett Wilson returned from a concussion against Buffalo and played 67 of 71 offensive snaps, catching seven of 14 targets for 106 yards. Geno Smith hit him for 33 yards in the second quarter, and Cade Klubnik found him for 29 in the third. Wilson drew five targets in the first half and nine in the second, staying involved through the quarterback changes. RotoBaller has him at WR10 for Week 11, with 13 catches for 189 yards on 26 targets over his last two ...
news.title: Garrett Wilson's Target Volume Keeps Him in the WR1 Tier for Week 11

news.contents: Las Vegas Raiders running back Mike Washington Jr. still has fantasy value to offer as his team prepares to face the Denver Broncos in Week 11. The rookie had eight carries for 23 yards and caught a pass for an additional four yards in a Week 10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks, which was a solid bounce-back following a dismal outing against the San Francisco 49ers. Washington has been a more efficient back than teammate Ashton Jeanty this season, although his workload isn't locked in now that ...
news.title: Mike Washington Jr. Has Deep-League Flex Appeal in Week 11 vs. Broncos

news.analysis: Donaldson has underwhelmed in the New Orleans offense, finishing with less than 40 offensive yards in each of his eight games. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 12 contest against the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.contents: CJ Donaldson rushed one time for five yards while also catching all four of his targets for 12 yards with one fumble lost in the Saints' 21-13 loss to the Bears in Week 11.
news.title: CJ Donaldson sees five touches in Week 11
